svg.title: Step 3: make a square
svg.desc: An animation, seen from above, of two attempts at step 3. In the first, the robot drives a side and turns a corner three times, drawing an open box that stops one side short of its start mark. In the second, it does it four times, drawing a closed square, and ends on its start mark facing the way it began. Beside it, a box names each side and corner as it happens and says whether the shape closed.
svg.text: A wrong shape is information: it tells
you what to change. Here, one more side
and one more corner close the square.

g.text: back at the start, facing the same way
